limits: This is not full Marg feature parity.
Credit limits use current posted customer balance; unbilled orders are not cumulatively reserved against the limit.
Purchase planning does not subtract pending purchase orders; drafts require review before saving.
Explicit bill matching is separate from the existing FIFO ageing reports; unmatched opening balances are shown separately.
Sales analysis covers item document values before tax and extra charges, not ledger-only sales.
Retail policies, bill matching, pricebook definitions and attachments remain local under the current Tally API contract.
Cloud sync has automated contract tests, not live-business acceptance. Master rename/delete propagation is limited by name-based connector matching.
